method: Analytic extrema of cubic Hermite vertical / horizontal derivative ratio; polynomial critical-point isolation. 16 m transition checks and declared full-section ownership are separate. Pedestrian paths, steps, cycleways and waterways are excluded from motor-road limits and listed for their own route-specific review. Roads use the exact piecewise-linear surface gradient; railway pieces include their stored endpoint tangents. Both retained source road paths and the distinct authored operating road network are audited.
